name: French Tech Visa

requirements.blocker_text: This requires being a founder of, employee of (in a qualifying role), or investor in a company recognised under the French Tech label — including a fast-tracked incubator-endorsed process for startup founders.
requirements.fix_path: Secure a role with, or recognition from, a French Tech-labeled company or incubator.

evidence_required.document: French Tech label confirmation or incubator endorsement

sources.title: La French Tech — French Tech Visa (official government-backed programme)

notes: Not a fully distinct legal visa category under CESEDA — administratively, the French Tech Visa is a fast-tracked processing route (2-4 weeks per some sources) INTO the existing Passeport Talent categories (salarié qualifié, créateur d'entreprise, projet innovant), rather than a separate legal status of its own. Modeled as its own route file here because it has a genuinely distinct qualifying gate (French Tech label recognition) and a materially different processing experience, consistent with how other countries in this dataset (e.g. UK's Global Talent vs standard Skilled Worker) sometimes warrant separate files despite overlapping underlying legal categories. No separate salary threshold of its own — inherits whichever Passeport Talent sub-category applies to the specific role (salarié qualifié's €39,582, or the créateur d'entreprise/entrepreneur criteria for founders). Genuinely fast processing (2-4 weeks) is a real practical advantage worth surfacing distinctly from the standard 4-6 month Passeport Talent timeline mentioned on fr_talent_salarie_qualifie.
